name: MonarchComparisonSection
title: ComparisonSection
wrapsNative: VStack of MonarchMarketingSectionHeader, a ScrollView(.horizontal) with MonarchPricingTable in its grid layout without prices, best-for cards and MonarchFlowLayout actions
summary: The product beside its alternatives: a header, a table comparing them feature by feature, cards that say who each option suits, a note on sources and a call to action.
whenToUse: On an about or upgrade screen that explains how the product differs from the ways people work today, with sourced rows.
whenNotToUse: To compare plans of the same product, use MonarchPricingTable or MonarchPricingSection. For data that is not a comparison, use Grid or MonarchDataTable.
api: init(_ title: String, eyebrow: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, alignment: MonarchMarketingAlignment = .leading, columns: [MonarchComparisonColumn], rows: [MonarchPricingFeature], caption: String? = nil, bestFor: [MonarchComparisonBestFor] = [], note: String? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

options.name: title
options.description: The section title; also the table's spoken name unless caption is given.

options.name: eyebrow
options.description: A short label above the title.

options.name: description
options.description: One or two sentences under the title.

options.name: alignment
options.description: Leading or centred header and actions.

options.name: columns
options.description: The product and its alternatives: id, name, badge and highlighted flag.

options.name: rows
options.description: The features: label, optional group and a value per column id (true, false or text).

options.name: caption
options.description: The spoken name of the table.

options.name: bestFor
options.description: Cards under the table that say who each option suits.

options.name: note
options.description: Sources, the date of the check and trademark credits, on the subtle background.

options.name: actions
options.description: One or two buttons at the end.

states.name: table
states.description: Columns keep a readable width; the table scrolls sideways when they do not fit. A highlighted column has its badge and an accent fill; group titles separate the rows.

states.name: best for
states.description: Up to two cards side by side, more in a stack; a highlighted card uses the accent's subtle colours.

states.name: note
states.description: A sentence on the subtle background.

appearance: The table follows MonarchPricingTable: checks in the strong success colour, dashes in the subtle text colour. Best-for cards use the surface colour and subtle border, or the accent's subtle fill and border when highlighted. The note uses the subtle background and the muted text colour. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web ComparisonSection is a marketing band whose table scrolls sideways on narrow screens with the feature column pinned. On iOS the table is MonarchPricingTable's grid in a horizontal scroll view: it fills a wide screen and scrolls sideways on a phone when the options do not fit; the feature column scrolls with it. The band draws no background of its own. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The title has the header trait; the table is a container named by the title or caption.
Each cell is read as the option, the feature and "Included", "Not included" or the text; checks and dashes are hidden.
Each best-for card is one element read as its title and description.
Each action stays its own button.
edgeCases: On a phone three or more columns scroll sideways; the feature column is not pinned.
A value missing for a column is read as "Not included".

examples.title: Product beside manual alternatives
Table only, centred
examples.code:
MonarchComparisonSection(
    "Before and after",
    alignment: .center,
    columns: [
        MonarchComparisonColumn("product", name: "Product A", badge: "This product", isHighlighted: true),
        MonarchComparisonColumn("sheets", name: "Spreadsheets"),
    ],
    rows: [
        MonarchPricingFeature("history", label: "Change history", values: ["product": true, "sheets": "Per file"]),
        MonarchPricingFeature("assign", label: "Assign an owner", values: ["product": true, "sheets": false]),
    ]
)
